name: Outplay
description_en:
Outplay coordinates prospecting and follow-up across email, phone, social and SMS on qualifying plans. The original outplayhq.com entry redirects to outplay.ai, which presents the current product. Its Free Forever card describes manual email outreach and click-to-dial; automated multichannel engagement is a paid-plan evaluation. Do not treat the broader AI and coaching homepage as an entitlement list for every account.

For a pilot, add approved prospects, connect the chosen mailbox and CRM, write a short sequence and assign replies to a rep. Confirm the CRM fields and owner before importing at scale. The official site describes a centralized inbox, sequence rules and pauses; their exact failure recovery and deduplication behavior were not tested. An email-only team can start with a narrower paid scope rather than assuming it needs power dialing.
description_zh:
Outplay 在相应套餐中协调邮件、电话、社交与短信的找客户及跟进。原 outplayhq.com 入口跳转至展示当前产品的 outplay.ai。Free Forever 卡片描述手动邮件触达与点击拨号，自动多渠道跟进则需评估付费套餐。不能把首页所有 AI 与辅导功能视为每个账户的权益清单。

试点可加入经授权线索，连接选定邮箱和 CRM，编写简短序列，并把回复分配给销售。大规模导入前应核对 CRM 字段与负责人。官网描述统一收件箱、序列规则和暂停，但本次未实测精确的失败恢复与去重行为。只使用邮件的团队可先评估较窄的付费范围，未必需要强力拨号。

items.en: Outplay is a candidate for a team moving from spreadsheets into owned sequences and a shared reply queue. More involved permissions, power dialing and voicemail appear in higher plan descriptions. A personal manual process may fit the free scope, while unattended follow-up requires explicit entitlement checks. The reviewed product is an online service; self-hosting and source licensing were not established. If sending stalls, inspect provider connection, sequence state and recipient status before repeating actions.
items.zh: 当团队从表格转向有负责人的序列与共享回复队列时，可考虑 Outplay。更复杂权限、强力拨号与语音信箱出现在较高套餐描述中。个人手动流程可能适合免费范围，无人值守跟进则需明确核对权益。本次产品为在线服务，未确认自托管与源代码许可。发送停滞时应先检查供应商连接、序列与收件人状态，再重复动作。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The visible annual view lists Starter $39/month, Growth $89/user/month and Enterprise $139/user/month. Free Forever lists 2,000 active prospects/month and two mailboxes, while Starter adds automated email and CRM integrations. A seven-day no-card trial is advertised on the homepage. Some comparison cells lose yes/no icons in text extraction, so this profile relies on explicit cards and wording rather than inferring every checkbox. Verify calling charges, limits and the actual commitment in checkout.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 可见年付视图列 Starter 每月 39 美元、Growth 每用户月价 89、Enterprise 139。Free Forever 列每月 2,000 活跃线索与两个邮箱；Starter 增加自动邮件和 CRM 集成。首页宣传七天免卡试用。部分对照表勾选图标在文本读取时丢失，因此本文依据明确卡片与文字，不推断每个勾选项。通话费用、限制与实际承诺期仍需在结算时确认。
